ms.promise:
The outputs resulting from the project:
・Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): The project aims to track the total number of people watching the Cardanati YouTube channel. By monitoring this metric, the project can assess its viewership and engagement over time. Comparing the total views in January 2024 with months of the project onboarding can provide insights into the project's growth and impact. So the numbers of views/ subscribers/ followers will be compared between 2 timeslots : "beginning of the project", and "end of the project".
・Duration and Frequency of Videos: The project plans to publish videos with a duration of 5-15 minutes, ensuring that they are short and concise. This approach aims to cater to the audience's preferences for easily digestible content. Publishing around 4 hours of content in Arabic per month indicates a consistent effort to provide regular updates and educational material. There is no empirical rule that states what percentage of what kind of non arabic-dubbed videos will be posted each month, as those are set to be 7 per month. Bear in mind that this project does not intended to do a Marketing campaign, the only effort on promotion expected from this project should be the sharing of all the content on Twitter/X, and interaction with people in comment sections.
Tracking metrics such as the number of subscribers, total views, and watch time can provide insights into the reach and engagement of the content. These metrics can be used to assess the project's success.
